description_expanded: This 2-bedroom vacation rental on the 3rd Floor of the Whitby building offers views of the Town Center Amphitheatre from your spacious balcony. The family room, kitchen and dining area is an open concept perfect for entertaining. The primary suite offers one king-sized bed with plenty of natural light facing the Amphitheatre. The guest bedroom has one queen-sized bed and full bath just off the main living area. Parking for this condo is in one designated space in a parking court behind the building. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
